names.note: Read out of «Sfântul Apostol Filip» in doxologia.ro's account of the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles for 30 iunie.
Read out of saint.gr's list of the twelve on its page for the Synaxis of 30 Ιουνίου, «Φίλιππος», with no rank word attached.
The bare name out of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2291, headed «Филипп, апостол из 12-ти»; the day's own line declines it. Five other folders already store this form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 ноября ст. ст. — «Апостола Филиппа (ок. 81-96).»
source.note: The life page's «Дни памяти» line adds 30 июня, which is the Synaxis of the Twelve and not a second proper feast; the day page for 14 ноября is what names him here.

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps 30 iunie as the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, a common commemoration of all of them, and names each apostle in turn. It also keeps him alone on 14 noiembrie, his own day, with a full life and a proper troparion of his own. Both days are now recorded, each as its own Romanian attestation with its own source.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 iunie — «Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli», whose life names him: «Sfântul Apostol Filip»

feast.note: His own day in the Romanian calendar, where the line reads «Sfântul Apostol Filip, unul dintre cei 12 Apostoli», with a full life, a proper troparion and a canon. The day also holds Gregory Palamas and his family. The Synaxis of the Twelve on 30 iunie is recorded separately.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 noiembrie — «† Sfântul Apostol Filip, unul dintre cei 12 Apostoli»

feast.note: saint.gr keeps 30 Ιουνίου as the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, a common commemoration of all of them, and its page names each apostle in turn, this one among them. His own Greek day has not been read in this wave, and saint.gr will have a page for it; the corpus keeps one feast to a church, so the synaxis day is what is recorded here and whether the proper day should replace it is a question left to the writer (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Ιουνίου — «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων», whose page names him among the twelve

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Cei ce sunteţi între apostoli mai întâi pe scaun şezători şi lumii învăţători, Stăpânului tuturor rugaţi-vă să dăruiască pace lumii şi sufletelor noastre mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Tropar la Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli; the troparion is printed for the twelve together.

english.text: O ye who are first enthroned among the Apostles and teachers of the world, pray to the Master of all that He grant peace to the world and to our souls great mercy.

hymns.text: Apostole Sfinte Filip, roagă pe Milostivul Dumnezeu să dăruiască iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Apostol Filip», glas 3, from the Tropar tab of his own page for 14 noiembrie; his proper, as against the common of the Twelve already cited here

english.text: Holy Apostle Philip, pray to the merciful God that He grant our souls forgiveness of offences.

hymns.text: Ὡς δωδεκάπυρσος, λυχνία ἔλαμψαν, οἱ Δωδεκάριθμοι, Χριστοῦ Ἀπόστολοι, Πέτρος καὶ Παῦλος σὺν Λουκᾶ, Ἀνδρέας καὶ Ἰωάννης, Βαρθολομαῖος Φίλιππος, σὺν Ματθαίω καὶ Σίμωνι, Μᾶρκος καὶ Ἰάκωβος, καὶ Θωμὰς ὁ μακάριος, καὶ ηὔγασαν τοὺς πίστει βοώντας χαίρετε Λόγου οἱ αὐτόπται.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — the first of the three the page prints, which names him among the twelve, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: As a lamp-stand of twelve flames the Apostles of Christ, twelve in number, shone out — Peter and Paul with Luke, Andrew and John, Bartholomew, Philip, with Matthew and Simon, Mark and James, and the blessed Thomas — and they gave light to those who cry out in faith: Rejoice, you who beheld the Word with your own eyes.

hymns.text: Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, καὶ τῆς Οἰκουμένης διδάσκαλοι, τῷ Δεσπότῃ τῶν ὅλων πρεσβεύσατε, εἰρήνην τῆ οἰκουμένῃ δωρήσασθαι, καὶ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: First-enthroned of the Apostles and teachers of the whole world, intercede with the Master of all things that He grant peace to the world and great mercy to our souls.

hymns.text: Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι, πρεσβεύσατε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ , ἵνα πταισμάτων ἄφεσιν, παράσχῃ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ´ — the common of the apostles, naming nobody, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: Holy Apostles, intercede with the merciful God, that He grant to our souls the forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Τοὺς ἀσφαλεῖς καὶ θεοφθόγγους κήρυκας, τὴν κορυφὴν τῶν Μαθητῶν σου Κύριε, προσελάβου εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν, τῶν ἀγαθῶν σου καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν, τοὺς πόνους γὰρ ἐκείνων καὶ τὸν θάνατον, ἐδέξω ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν ὁλοκάρπωσιν, ὁ μόνος γινώσκων τὰ ἐγκάρδια.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τοὺς ἀσφαλεῖς, on the page of «Σύναξη των Αγίων Δώδεκα Αποστόλων»

english.text: The sure and God-inspired heralds, the chief of Thy disciples, Thou hast taken to Thyself, O Lord, into the enjoyment of Thy good things and into rest; for Thou didst accept their labours and their death above every whole burnt offering, O Thou who alone knowest the secrets of the heart.

hymns.text: Благоукрашается вселенная,/ Ефиопия ликовствует,/ яко венцем красуема,/ тобою просветившися,/ светло торжествует память твою,/ богоглаголиве Филиппе,/ вся бо веровати Христу научил еси/ и течение совершил достойно Евангелия./ Тем дерзновенно варит Ефиопская рука к Богу,// Егоже моли даровати нам велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостола Филиппа»
source.note: Printed under his own heading and naming him and no other saint, so it is his. It credits the enlightening of Ethiopia to him, which the calendar's own life of him does not: that life has Galilee, Greece, Parthia, Azotus and the two Hierapoleis.

english.text: The whole world is adorned and Ethiopia dances for joy, decked as with a crown, for she was enlightened by you; brightly she keeps the feast of your memory, Philip who spoke of God. For you taught all men to believe in Christ and finished your course worthily of the Gospel. Therefore the hand of Ethiopia is stretched out boldly to God, whom entreat to grant us His great mercy.

hymns.text: Ученик и друг Твой и подражатель страсти Твоея,/ вселенней Бога Тя проповеда богоглаголивый Филипп;/ того молитвами от врагов пребеззаконных/ Церковь Твою и всяк град Твой// Богородицею соблюди, Многомилостиве.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостола Филиппа»

english.text: Your disciple and friend and imitator of Your passion, Philip who spoke of God, preached You to the world as God. By his prayers keep Your Church and every city of Yours from utterly lawless enemies, through the Theotokos, O most merciful One.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru: «Апостола Филиппа (ок. 81-96).» Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave a year.
